scientific_integrity: The theorem and its complete proof are stated without claiming independent validation; code verifies the stated bounded finite checks. Originality comparison is a self-review with acknowledged remaining source risks.
scientific_limitations: Binary vector spaces only, and indicator-support sizes at most six. The general theorem is proved by affine normal forms and closed counting; exhaustive computation was limited to dimensions three through five. A historical equivalent in small-weight Boolean tables remains possible.
title: Six-point affine-circuit threshold for the Boolean Fourier algebra norm
